messages:
zoe: Quick QA pass on Compliance -> Storage. Found a few small UX/a11y/copy nits. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/Compliance-Storage
liam: Drop them here and I'll create the frontend ticket.
zoe: 1) 'Data expiry' feels awkward; propose 'Retention period' or 'How long data is kept'. For the numeric input show label 'Retention period (days)'. Auditors liked seeing the word 'retention'.
andre: +1. 2) Toggle state: current 'Never delete' option leaves the days input visible and editable, which confused users. Design suggests collapsing to a single chip 'Kept indefinitely' and hiding the numeric input.
maria: Implementation detail: hide the numeric input from assistive tech (aria-hidden) and add an aria-live message "Retention set to kept indefinitely" when toggled so screen reader users get feedback.
samuel: Also check tab order: keyboard flow currently jumps from region to audit link skipping retention. Ticket should include reproduction steps and acceptance tests for focus order.
zoe: 3) Region picker ordering: reorder by org usage and add a small 'Recommended' badge for the preferred region. Add hint text under the control: 'Region affects where data is stored and can affect latency' wired via aria-describedby.
liam: Will implement aria-describedby like <select aria-describedby="region-hint"> and include the hint span.
andre: 4) KMS badge copy: replace 'Customer key' with 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. Add aria-label 'Encryption key: customer-managed (BYOK)'. When multiple keys exist add a 'Key info' link that opens a drawer with Key ID, created on, last rotated, and rotation policy. Drawer must be role=dialog, aria-modal=true and move focus to heading.
maria: Copy tweak for audit logs: append 'UTC' to timestamps (e.g., 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC) and standardize CSV export header to 'timestamp_utc'. Policy wants consistent UTC format.
policy-bot: [policy] Confirmed: export header must be 'timestamp_utc' and UI should default to UTC display per /policies/retention/export-format.
zoe: Nice. Action items: liam create frontend ticket (aria-hidden, aria-live, hint binding, ordering), andre mock drawer and post figma, samuel write accessibility acceptance criteria, maria confirm BYOK string with security. I will coordinate QA.
liam: Ticket started and will link PR here when ready.
andre: Drawer artboard posted in figma.
policy-bot: [reminder] Compliance review scheduled Tue 11:00 PT — bring final copy and a11y checklist.
zoe: Thanks all — tagging @samuel for a11y signoff, @maria for security copy, @liam for implementation. :white_check_mark:
